title: Porch: An Architecture of Generosity (US Pavilion 2025), design rendering of the porch in the forecourt
contents: Photorealistic design rendering (before construction) of the 2025 timber porch with folded blue canopies built in front of and around the US Pavilion; the pavilion's brick side wall and portico are partly visible behind the slats. No scale.
author: Marlon Blackwell Architects (design team with Stephen Burks Man Made and Julie Bargmann / D.I.R.T. studio)
evidence: Image URL embedded in the Next.js payload of the project page (guard get OK 14:42 after the soft refusal of 13:57 expired); guard check ALLOWED, get OK -> _work/guard/pages/cdn.sanity.io/7de7d7e1_b87414d9c2fe64014d1557eec809c309ddbf4b96-2560x1440.jpg (859472 bytes); peek info JPEG 2560x1440; crop viewed: rendered people and slats (a rendering, not a photo).
notes: Only non-photo among the 19 images of the Blackwell project page (the other 18 are Tim Hursley-style photos of the built porch and two interior gallery views: photo source, no rows). Temporary installation drawn on the real pavilion -> us-reno; the pavilion is mostly hidden, so related, not drawing.
